product_claim.reason: The product includes QML, JavaScript, Python, shell, Qt, Quickshell, Linux, and an external JACKAL runtime outside the SPARK proof boundary.

component_claims.boundary: Pure finite policy functions only; no parser, process, operating-system, UI-rendering, compiler, or source-to-JavaScript refinement claim.

requirements.shall: The SPARK policy kernel shall classify every finite doctor-policy input and shall return Functional if and only if discovery is ready, canonical probe rows are present and complete, every probe passes, and runtime identity matches.
The SPARK policy kernel shall implement the complete priority-ordered display-state classification specified by Required_State for every State_Input value.

The SPARK policy kernel shall return Verified if and only if a report is present, error-free, installed, identity-matched, not verification-failed, fresh, probed, fully passing, and functionally reported.
The SPARK policy kernel shall return no mathematical ceiling for an empty declaration and otherwise return the canonical strongest member of the declared mathematical-status set.

The SPARK policy kernel shall report a consequence cap exactly when the family does not carry the axis, both declarations are nonempty, and the strongest declared consequence requires less mathematical strength than the canonical assurance ceiling.
The shipped Model.js policy shall conform to every finite state, mathematical-set, and consequence-set vector emitted by the proved SPARK policy kernel.
residuals: Differential conformance is not a formal source-to-source refinement proof.
JavaScript number and time handling outside the finite policy abstraction remain tested, not proved.

requirements.shall: The operator surface shall keep installed presence, runtime integrity, and sampled function as separate observations and shall not report FUNCTIONAL unless its canonical probes and identity self-test pass.
residuals: Finite probes do not establish universal correctness.
Runtime identity does not establish operating-system or hardware correctness.

requirements.shall: The dropdown shall preserve returned assurance vocabulary, refusal identity, consequence ceilings, and graph non-evidence labels without promoting them through color or wording.
residuals: QML rendering and compositor behavior are not inside the SPARK proof boundary.

requirements.shall: Two independent clean checkouts of the same committed source shall produce byte-identical release archives and matching transport digest files.
residuals: A checksum and reproducible source archive do not authenticate a publisher.

requirements.shall: The public automation shall run the mandatory formal repository gate, shall pin every third-party action to an immutable commit identifier, and shall select explicit GNAT, GPRbuild, and GNATprove versions.
residuals: A passing hosted workflow does not qualify the runner, toolchain, operating system, or hardware.
Hosted CI availability is outside this repository's control.
